paper.title: Identification and Estimation of Treatment and Interference Effects in Observational Studies on Networks

paper_reference.paper_question: 观察性网络中，如何用本人和邻居的处理前协变量识别干扰效应？
paper_reference.target: 甲不参加时，至少一位朋友参加减朋友都不参加，甲测验成绩之差；按甲自身学习困难和朋友中学习困难人数两层各1/2加权，只评价甲。
paper_reference.source_location: Forastiere et al. (2021) JASA, DOI 10.1080/01621459.2020.1768100; author manuscript arXiv:1609.06245, Theorem 1 and Eq. (7).
conditions: Conditional exchangeability/mean sufficiency given own X, number of friends with X=1, and fixed W.
Positivity for the two friend-participation states.
what_paper_supports: Covariate adjustment for observational network interference.
Own and peer covariates must be retained.
Conditional exchangeability is an assumption, not a data fact.
what_paper_does_not_support: No replication of the full ADRF or Add Health analysis.

missing_condition.reason: Conditional exchangeability is explicitly not adopted.

changed_target.reason: Reverse comparison; expected sign is flipped.

actual_run.provenance: demo lit_observational_peers saved run, independent replay true. Not a fresh call.

adjustment_schema.neighbor_summary: count of undirected neighbors with pre-treatment X=1
